core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; Retail Pharmacy; Personal Care & Wellness
specialty_focus: Farmacias Ahumada is a major Chilean pharmacy chain founded in 1968. Formerly owned by Walgreens Boots Alliance , it was acquired in late 2023 by a consortium of Chilean investors led by LarrainVial Activos . It operates nearly 300 stores providing medicines, beauty items, and wellness products.
